{{Quote|I need a place to do my research, but I'm a bit short of funding. Then I found this place, only it's overrun with all these creatures. Can you rid the bunker of some of them for me?|Lejo Daramus, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:VB" />}}
'''Lejo Daramus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] scientist who resided and experimented on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:VB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Daramus needed a new place to conduct his research but was short of funding. He finally found an [[Abandoned Bunker|abandoned bunker]] near the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] but the building was overrun by fiendish [[durni]]s.<ref name="SWG:VB" /> The scientist luckily met a spacer who visited the bunker while investigating an assassination attempt on [[Deel Draav]], the mayor of Kor Vella.<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: The Lucky Mayor|Corellia}}</ref> Daramus proposed to pay the spacer to rid the place of the creatures and the spacer accepted. The scientist was eventually able to start setting up his equipment and turn the bunker into a laboratory.<ref name="SWG:VB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lejo Daramus appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:VB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lejo Daramus was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
